description: This file defines functions and classes related to nested tensors in PyTorch, including creation, conversion, and manipulation of nested and jagged tensors, as well as related utilities like masking and narrowing.

classes.name: NestedTensor
classes.description: Alias for torch.Tensor with nested tensor functionalities (imported as _NestedTensor)

methods.name: as_nested_tensor
methods.description: Constructs a nested tensor from a tensor or list/tuple of tensors, preserving autograd history.

methods.name: nested_tensor
methods.description: Creates a nested tensor with no autograd history from a list of tensors.

methods.name: narrow
methods.description: Creates a narrowed nested tensor view from a strided tensor, supporting different layouts.

methods.name: nested_tensor_from_jagged
methods.description: Builds a jagged layout nested tensor from values, offsets, and lengths.

methods.name: masked_select
methods.description: Creates a nested tensor with values where the mask is True, preserving the mask's shape.
